## Summary

Describe the problem and resulting behavior. Link the iteration/work items and
identify the base branch and relevant commits.

## Behavior and implementation

Explain the change by component, including important compatibility effects.

## Decisions to review

Identify choices that need review and their reasons. Omit this section if none.

## Integration handoff

Identify dependencies or follow-up work. Omit this section if none.

## Validation

Give commands and results, the revision tested, and relevant checks not performed.

## AI-assisted development

Identify the AI tools and their contribution. State actual human review status.
Keep private transcripts and credentials out of the PR.

## Wiki update

List affected pages, the proposed changes, and the post-merge follow-up owner,
or give a brief reason why no update is needed. Evaluation plans and thresholds
must be committed before their evaluation runs.
